source_record.bounded_interface_domain: The specifically named receiving question, configuration or adverse observation delimits what actual-work inquiry should observe or how its result may be interpreted. The named object, configuration, relevant time/population and actual receiving use are identified. Similar language, possible encoding, organizational co-use or an arbitrary tool does not establish a bridge. Unknown applicability remains unknown. A supported partial premise can be material while the whole receiving predicate remains unestablished.
source_record.domain_horizon_authority: The exact member object, configuration, observation interval, consequence and actual authority in each literal argument; no adoption or legal applicability inference.
source_record.evidence_ceiling: No source claim that direct observation is neutral, exhaustive, universally superior or a causal intervention is introduced. Analytical native-role inference only; no empirical effect size, universal benefit, new historical descent or final scientific acceptance.
source_record.common_cost_and_alternative: Access, consent/privacy, nonpunitive testimony, representative sampling, observation effects, trace integrity and interpretation time count. For well-instrumented low-risk routine work, periodic sampling and exception inquiry can be adequate.

exceptions.treatment: Already assigned exact prior argument; preserved unchanged, excluded from this rule membership.

attempted_contrary_interfaces: Generic co-use or arbitrary supporting tool rejected.
Whole receiving predicate failure does not erase a materially used partial input.

positive_controls.argument: A requirement with an interpretable evidence method identifies the observation question and missing channel, limiting what the actual-work inquiry can claim from seeing a local event.
Distinct integration observations identify dependencies that a local inquiry cannot see directly and specify additional traces or testimony needed before extrapolating.
Intended-use criteria and representative context identify whose work and which outcome the inquiry must examine; they can disqualify a locally convenient proxy.
The qualification envelope and representative-article assumptions specify which conditions and identities an actual-work inquiry must establish before reusing an observation.
Actual acceptance criteria and the identity of the delivered item focus observation on the decision-relevant configuration and disclose the distinction between evidence and acceptance.
The applicable basis constrains which observation, configuration, access and witness roles can receive credit in that claim.
Competent protected challenge can reveal observer effects, missing voices or a local-to-global inference error and redirect the actual-work inquiry.
A hazard scenario identifies consequential but potentially invisible states and interactions that the inquiry must instrument or investigate through records and testimony.
Claim decomposition and explicit defeaters specify which actual-work question remains unanswered and which observation can bear on it.
Readiness conditions and actual cutover identities identify the people, environments and transitions the inquiry must examine, limiting transfer from a demonstration.
Versioned operational records and observed exceptions provide temporal and distributed evidence beyond a brief local visit.
The actual risk decision and controlled conditions identify which evidence uncertainty matters and whose exposure must be examined.
